archetypes.name: diagram-flow
archetypes.rationale: Diagram lifecycle moved across approval and publish boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new /design Step 5b.5 routing end to end. Focus on Gate C approval ordering, pause/resume step detection, Step 5c fail-closed behavior, and skip-marker clearing semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: log-hygiene
archetypes.rationale: The change intentionally constrains Mermaid-bearing captures in durable logs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit diagram failure handling for accidental Mermaid or raw generator output reaching committed design or implement run logs. Check bounded sidecars, execution-issues appends, and top-level run-log exclusions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
